label: Recreate table change
summary: Recreates table change to apply schema changes: database/change/unique:host,repoId,externalId

precheck.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 AS "result" FROM "sqlite_master" WHERE ("type" = ? AND "name" = ?)

precheck.description: ensure temp table "_prisma_new_change" does not exist
precheck.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) = 0 AS "result" FROM "sqlite_master" WHERE ("type" = ? AND "name" = ?)

execute.description: create new table "_prisma_new_change" with desired schema
execute.sql:
CREATE TABLE "_prisma_new_change" (
  "activityAt" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "baseRef" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "body" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "checks" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')) NOT NULL,
  "draftAt" TEXT,
  "externalId" TEXT,
  "headRef" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "headSha" TEXT,
  "host" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "landedAt" TEXT,
  "mergeable" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "observedAt" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "openedByAgentId" TEXT,
  "raw" TEXT,
  "repoId" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "review" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "stage" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "title" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "url" TEXT,
  "withdrawnAt" TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  UNIQUE ("host", "repoId", "externalId")
)

postcheck.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 AS "result" FROM "sqlite_master" WHERE ("type" = ? AND "name" = ?)
SELECT COUNT(*) = 0 AS "result" FROM "sqlite_master" WHERE ("type" = ? AND "name" = ?)

postcheck.description: verify unique constraint (host, repoId, externalId) on "change"
postcheck.sql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pragma_index_list('change') l WHERE l."unique" = 1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pragma_index_info(l.name)) = 3 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pragma_index_info(l.name) WHERE name IN ('host', 'repoId', 'externalId')) = 3)
